text:
Ashwin: FYI rolled out a kernel-fallback change to the runtime on canary ~2h ago. Seeing p95/p99 jumps for Llama3-13B chat traffic. Baseline p95 ~220ms -> 380ms, p99 ~450ms -> 720ms. Repro on corp canary, noisier on dedicated pools. :eyes:

Sophie: Can you paste the top-level profiler flame trace and kernel-selection logs?

Ashwin: Here's a shortened flame snapshot from the perf trace:
```
kernel_total: 420ms
 - kernel_switch: 180ms (42%)
 - kv_cache_lookup: 90ms (21%)
 - matmul_exec: 120ms (28%)
 - enqueue/wait: 30ms (7%)
```
Also seeing a lot of "fallback->generic" entries in the selector log around kernel selection.

Dmitri: That smells like KV eviction / stride mismatch. Does fallback happen only when compiled kernel head_dim != runtime head_dim? What's the exact decision rule in the selector now?

Ashwin: Selector config (current): prefer fused-attn kernel if (seq_len >= 128 && head_dim % 64 == 0) else fallback to generic. But we observe runtime switching to generic for mid-size seqs (128-256) unexpectedly.

Ryan: Do we have tail-latency by sequence-length buckets? Need to see where spike is concentrated.

Ashwin: Quick buckets from canary traces:
- <=64: p99 95ms
- 65-127: p99 150ms
- 128-256: p99 710ms
- 257-1024: p99 480ms
So the big spike is specifically in 128-256.

Sophie: Interesting. Could be rope_theta scaling + chat template causing longer effective positions and different KV reuse, but you said model rope_theta didn't change? Any model config diffs vs previous rollout?

Ashwin: Model metadata: Llama3-13B build 2026.02.14 -> hidden_size 5120, head_dim 128, RMSNorm+SiLU, rope_theta 10. Matches previous. The difference seems compile-path related: a new 'fused-attn-v2' kernel was produced during the latest build and the selector hash didn't match our runtime rules, so fallback frequency increased.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026.02.14-kkf rolled to canary at 16:42 UTC. Metrics: https://perf.redwood/roll/4182755

Julia: Immediate mitigation options:
- disable kernel_fallback on canary and force previous kernel version
- collect additional instrumentation: KV hit rate, kernel_id histogram, kernel_switch_count per-request
- run 5k synthetic chat templates with short prefixes (~20 tokens) and mid-length generations (total seq 128-256)

Ashwin: Patch plan: add a selector override to prefer fused-attn-v1 for head_dim==128 when seq_len in [128,256] and instrument 'kernel_switch_count' and 'kv_eviction_rate'. Concept diff below:
```
if model.head_dim == 128 and 128 <= seq_len <= 256:
  prefer_kernel('fused-attn-v1')
else:
  default_selector()
```
I'll also capture kernel_id histogram and KV eviction traces for the next canary run.

Ryan: SGTM. If the patch doesn't reduce p99 by >40% within 30m of canary run we rollback. I'll open a rollback PR and watch the metric dashboard. :+1:
